name: GearBeacon
releaseNotes: GearBeacon 1.4.0 includes all changes since 1.3.0: optional experimental auto-buy with exact-variant limits, a sandboxed checkout companion, clearer setup and profile verification; NEW TO STORE and NOW AVAILABLE Activity badges; configurable session locking, fresh owner verification and optional authenticator codes; Windows account-protected installation keys, restricted notification destinations, and signed update provenance. CI timing, dependency maintenance, and release ancestry are improved. Upgrade creates a validated backup before schema v13 to v15 migration and signs browsers out once. Exports use format v10 and restore purchase instructions paused. Existing saved-card support is required for auto-buy; authenticated live checkout compatibility remains unverified. Read the complete release notes for private-host approvals and Windows key transfer/rollback guidance.
